description: This PHP source file defines the 'Information' class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods for retrieving information records, their list, and layout IDs from a database, specifically related to the 'information' feature in the catalog module.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A model class responsible for fetching information data from the database, including individual information entries, lists of information, and layout IDs associated with information records.

methods.name: getInformation
methods.description: Retrieves a single information record based on the provided information ID, joining multiple tables for extended data.

methods.name: getInformations
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active information records for the current store and language, utilizing caching to improve performance.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific information record.
